assumptions: Each stained tube carries one fluorochrome; tubes acquired alike (beads, cells) share a name prefix, and the dimmest of each group is its negative.
The autofluorescence tube is unstained cells, used as it is.
limits: Fluorochrome names come from the tube names (the prefix and .fcs removed), as flowSpecs names them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What spectral signatures do these single-stain controls imply?

description: flowSpecs specMatCalc on spectral single-stain control tubes in the project: per tube, MAD gates on scatter and the brightest detector, the median of every detector; each group's dimmest tube subtracted, autofluorescence added, each signature scaled to its maximum.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

autofluorescence.description: which of the tubes is the unstained one whose spectrum is the autofluorescence, by name or id.

excluded.description: regular expression for the channels that are not detectors.

groups.description: the tube-name prefixes that group tubes acquired alike, comma-separated (Beads_, Dead_).

tubes.description: the control FCS files in the project, by name or id, comma-separated, the unstained and autofluorescence tubes included.

name: estimate_spectra_from_controls

matrix.description: the spectral matrix, rows the fluorochromes, columns the detectors

tubes.description: what each tube's gates kept, its brightest detector and its role
